---
title: "Progression-free survival — covariate imputation"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(mice)
library(miceadds)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "05-progression-free-survival", "results")
imputation_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "imputations")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(imputation_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

m <- config$imputation$m_supporting

prepared <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet")) |>
  mutate(diagnosis = factor(diagnosis), gender = factor(gender))

prepared <- prepared |>
  mutate(na_pfs = nelsonaalen(prepared, pfs_time_days, event_pfs))
```

## Adjusted (fixed): lung indicator

```{r}
#| label: setup-fixed
#| include: false
fixed_data <- prepared |>
  select(-diagnosis) |>
  mutate(ecog_fstcnt = ordered(ecog_fstcnt))

fixed_incomplete <- names(which(colSums(is.na(fixed_data)) > 0))

fixed_methods <- make.method(fixed_data)
fixed_methods[] <- ""
fixed_methods[fixed_incomplete] <- "pmm"
fixed_methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "polr"

fixed_predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(fixed_data)
fixed_predictors[, c("id", "pfs_time_days")] <- 0
fixed_predictors[!nzchar(fixed_methods), ] <- 0
```

## Adjusted (hierarchical): diagnosis random intercept

```{r}
#| label: setup-hierarchical
#| include: false
diagnosis_data <- prepared |>
  mutate(diagnosis_id = as.integer(diagnosis)) |>
  select(-diagnosis, -lung)

diagnosis_incomplete <- names(which(colSums(is.na(diagnosis_data)) > 0))

diagnosis_methods <- make.method(diagnosis_data)
diagnosis_methods[] <- ""
# ECOG is imputed as numeric, with the observed integer categories as donors.
diagnosis_methods[diagnosis_incomplete] <- "2l.pmm"

diagnosis_predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(diagnosis_data)
diagnosis_predictors[, c("id", "pfs_time_days")] <- 0
diagnosis_predictors[!nzchar(diagnosis_methods), ] <- 0
# -2 marks diagnosis_id as the cluster variable.
diagnosis_predictors[diagnosis_incomplete, "diagnosis_id"] <- -2
```

## Imputation

```{r}
#| label: impute
#| include: false
branches <- list(
  os_adjusted = list(
    data = fixed_data,
    methods = fixed_methods,
    predictors = fixed_predictors,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2200
  ),
  diagnosis = list(
    data = diagnosis_data,
    methods = diagnosis_methods,
    predictors = diagnosis_predictors,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2201
  )
)

imputations <- imap(branches, function(branch, adjustment) {
  imputation_path <- file.path(imputation_dir, paste0(adjustment, ".rds"))

  if (!file.exists(imputation_path)) {
    imputation <- mice(
      branch$data,
      method = branch$methods,
      predictorMatrix = branch$predictors,
      m = m,
      maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
      donors = config$imputation$donors,
      printFlag = FALSE,
      seed = branch$seed
    )
    saveRDS(imputation, imputation_path, compress = "xz")
  }

  readRDS(imputation_path)
})

stopifnot(
  all(imputations$diagnosis$predictorMatrix[diagnosis_incomplete, "diagnosis_id"] == -2)
)
```

## Completed datasets

```{r}
#| label: complete
#| include: false
completed <- map(imputations, function(imputation) {
  map(seq_len(m), function(index) {
    data <- complete(imputation, index) |>
      mutate(
        diagnosis = prepared$diagnosis,
        ecog_binary = derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt),
        mgps = factor(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein), levels = 0:2)
      )

    stopifnot(
      !anyNA(data),
      imputation$m == m,
      all(as.numeric(as.character(data$ecog_fstcnt)) %in% 0:4),
      all(as.integer(as.character(data$ecog_binary)) ==
            derive_ecog_binary(data$ecog_fstcnt)),
      all(as.integer(as.character(data$mgps)) ==
            derive_mgps(data$albumin, data$c_reactive_protein)),
      identical(data$pfs_time_days, prepared$pfs_time_days),
      identical(data$event_pfs, prepared$event_pfs)
    )

    data
  })
})

iwalk(completed, function(datasets, adjustment) {
  saveRDS(datasets, file.path(imputation_dir, paste0("completed-", adjustment, ".rds")))
})
```

```{r}
#| label: save-imputation-figures
#| include: false
laboratory_variables <- c(
  Albumin = "albumin",
  Bilirubin = "bilirubin",
  "C-reactive protein" = "c_reactive_protein",
  "Lactate dehydrogenase" = "lactate_dehydrogenase"
)

iwalk(imputations, function(imputation, adjustment) {
  chain_stats <- mice_chain_stats(imputation)
  save_figure(
    plot_mice_traces(chain_stats),
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0("imputation-traces-", adjustment, ".png")),
    height = 1.5 * n_distinct(chain_stats$variable) + 1
  )

  laboratory_values <- imputed_values(imputation, laboratory_variables)
  save_figure(
    plot_imputed_densities(laboratory_values$observed, laboratory_values$imputed),
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0("imputation-distributions-", adjustment, ".png")),
    height = 5
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-pfs-imputation-checks
#| fig-cap: "Imputation traces and laboratory distributions: Adjusted (fixed) followed by Adjusted (hierarchical)"
#| fig-alt: "Means and standard deviations across MICE iterations, and observed-versus-imputed laboratory densities, for each of the two five-imputation analyses."
include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, c(
  "imputation-traces-os_adjusted.png",
  "imputation-distributions-os_adjusted.png",
  "imputation-traces-diagnosis.png",
  "imputation-distributions-diagnosis.png"
)))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pfs-imputation-events
imputations |>
  imap(function(imputation, adjustment) {
    if (is.null(imputation$loggedEvents)) return(tibble())

    imputation$loggedEvents |>
      count(dep, meth, out) |>
      mutate(adjustment = adjustment)
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  kable()
```
